sources.title: Katarina Build Guide: [ALL MATCHUPS] [26.19] Acee1's Katarina Guide

passive.name: Voracity
passive.text: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

spells.name: Bouncing Blade
spells.text: Katarina throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.

spells.name: Preparation
spells.text: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a Dagger into the air directly above herself.

spells.name: Shunpo
spells.text: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.

spells.name: Death Lotus
spells.text: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.

damage.value: Katarina deals sustained magic damage while she channels Death Lotus.

archetype.value: Katarina is a melee AP assassin who uses daggers, resets, and roams to find kills.

winCondition.value: Katarina survives lane, roams, and turns teamfights with a well-timed Death Lotus.

spikes.why: Katarina looks to roam after surviving lane.
Katarina refunds 15 seconds of her ability cooldowns, letting her chain Shunpos through a fight.

spikes.at: Shunpo’s cooldown falling from 12 to 8 seconds
spikes.why: Katarina can blink to targets more often.

bait.why: Katarina's Death Lotus has a 90-second base cooldown, so spending it limits her next fight unless takedowns shorten that cooldown.
Katarina loses access to her Shunpo blink while it is on cooldown, unless Voracity reduces it.

mistakes.value: Katarina players can lose fights by missing a dagger pickup or failing to track crowd control.
